design_system.name: LastMile OS - Industrial Swiss
design_system.description: A high-performance, high-contrast, data-dense design system for logistics operations. Prioritizes legibility, speed, and status visibility.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1_setup: Install fonts via Google Fonts import in index.css. Update tailwind.config.js with the custom colors and font families.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2_layout: Create a 'DashboardLayout' component with a fixed sidebar and top header. Use the 'Bento' grid for the main dashboard view.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3_components: Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Industrial Swiss' aesthetic (rounded-sm, 1px borders, no heavy shadows).

step_4_pages.login: Use the 'login_bg' image with a heavy dark overlay. Center the login form card.
step_4_pages.dashboard: Implement the 4 KPI cards and the 'Journey Management Table'. Use progress bars with conditional colors (green/amber/red).
step_4_pages.journeys: Create a detailed view with tabs (Inicio, Incidencias, Fin). Use the file upload zone with drag-and-drop.
step_4_pages.file_upload: Use a dashed border zone with a clear CTA icon.

critical_rules: Ensure all UI labels are in Spanish as per user request.
Implement the 60-second polling logic for dashboard data.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for overlays/modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
